Both Kuff 'n' Klout have green eyes, although artwork depicts one of them with purple eyes. In Dixie Kong's Photo Album, Kuff 'n' Klout are classified as part of the "Kremling Kreeps" enemy class. Kuff 'n' Klouts attack by making movements akin to playing leapfrog or by racing about the screen, shoulder to shoulder. Some Kuff 'n' Klouts perform each action in succession to one another. The Giant Squirrel is a flying squirrel who was originally set to appear as a boss in Donkey Kong for the Game Boy before ultimately being removed from the final game. It makes its first and only proper appearance in the final chapter of the Game Boy Donkey Kong arc of KC Deluxe's Super Mario manga.

Cassandra Nova Xavier (commonly known as Cassandra Nova) is a Marvel Comics character who appears in Deadpool & Wolverine as the main antagonist. She is a Mutant with the powers of telekinesis and telepathy. She is ruthless and has a brilliant mind. Cassandra Nova was created by Grant Morrison and Frank Quitely, and was portrayed by Emma Corrin.

Xu Wenwu is the legendary leader of the Ten Rings, and a villain from Marvel Comics, Approximately 1000 years ago, Wenwu found ten powerful rings, which allow him to cast blasts of energy and granted him immortality, inspired by these rings, he named his organization the Ten Rings. Xu Wenwu is a composite character, based on the Mandarin, who was created by Stan Lee and Don Heck, and Fu Manchu, who was created by Sax Rohmer, while the Marvel version of Fu Manchu was created by Steve Englehart, Jim Starlin and Al Migrom.

Yaarp, also known as Experiment 613, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to create devastating sonic blasts that can shatter windows, flatten buildings, and cause acute loss of hearing. Luckily, he can also reduce these noises to soft, gentle honks. His one true place is at Lilo's hula school as an alien invasion alarm and buzzer.

Thomas "Tommy" Maximoff (later known as Thomas Shepherd) is a character in the Marvel Cinematic Universe who makes his debut in the Marvel Disney+ series WandaVision. Tommy first appears in the third episode "Now in Color" and is portrayed by Gavin Borders and Jett Klyne. His reincarnated form, named Tommy Shepherd, makes his debut in VisionQuest, with Ruaridh Mollica taking on the role. An alternate version of the character, originating from Earth-838, was featured in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness. He is the son of Wanda Maximoff and Vision, and the older twin brother of Billy Maximoff. He was conceived through the effects of Wanda's chaos magic, which also granted him super-s

The Big Bad Wolf (Full name: Zeke Midas "Ezekiel" Wolf) is the main antagonist of the Silly Symphony short The Three Little Pigs. As his name suggests, he is a ruthless, conniving wolf who variously plots to eat the Three Little Pigs. The crafty wolf often relies on gaudy disguises to accomplish his schemes. But his greatest attributes are his infamous "huffs and puffs", which are powerful enough to blow houses in.

Master Skellig Ro is a character who appears in the Disney Jr. animated series Miles from Tomorrowland. He is known as the greatest Naxos master in the universe. He lives alone on a planet called Iridium and barely anyone has even met him. Miles and Loretta's mother, Phoebe Callisto, is one of the lucky few who has ever met him in person as well learn beside him. In the weak gravity of Iridium, Skellig Ro is known to move fast as the wind, that people can only get a slight glimpse of him before he disappears without a trace. It is also shown that he is capable of controlling the weather, which he uses to test the skills of those who wish to learn from him.

Rescue Ronda is a toy helicopter that can really fly in the sky with her rotor propellers as she is built with a rescue line as Ronda once helped Stuffy when he fell and when Lambie was floating in the air by a balloon, Ronda told the toy what to do when her propeller cracked.

Melty, also known as Experiment 228, is an illegal genetic experiment created by Jumba Jookiba and a character in the Lilo & Stitch franchise. He is designed to liquefy enemy fortresses, weapons, and transportation by firing blue energy blasts that melt any solid object when hit. His one true place is melting metal at the aluminum recycling plant.

Anakin Skywalker is a major character in the Star Wars franchise. He is a legendary Force-user who served as a Jedi Knight until he fell to the dark side and became the Sith Lord Darth Vader. As a child, Anakin was a slave on the desert planet Tatooine until Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn found him. He theorized that he was the Chosen One destined to bring balance to the Force. Anakin trained as a Padawan under Obi-Wan Kenobi, served as a Jedi Knight of the Galactic Republic, and later trained his own apprentice, Ahsoka Tano. Despite the Jedi Order's rule against attachments, Anakin secretly marries Padmé Amidala. By the end of the Clone Wars, Anakin falls to the dark side and becomes Darth Vader

Human Torch (real name Johnny Storm) is a Marvel Comics character who is a member of the Fantastic Four and the younger brother of Susan Storm. He has the power to transform into a being of fire. The Human Torch was created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.

Emma Frost (also known as the White Queen) is a character who appears in the Marvel Studios Animation series X-Men '97. She is a mutant telepath and a member of the Inner Circle. Emma Frost was created by Chris Claremont and John Byrne.

The Elevator Monster is a psychic being from Super Robot Monkey Team Hyperforce Go! that serves the Skeleton King. He looks like an old man, except that below his waist is an elevator-like protrusion instead of feet. He has the ability to transport anybody who comes into the elevator to a completely different spot. He has disguised himself as an old man in an elevator, leaving many people inconspicuous.

Yasova Dragonclaw was a khan in the past of Tarkir who led the Temur Frontier. She was a powerful shaman, adept at calling upon the elemental forces of the mountains and turning her enemies' power against themselves. After the fall of the khans, Yasova lost her Dragonclaw title and was renamed Yasova First Mother. She had a sabertooth named Anchin who was her companion.

Treva was one of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria. Her name meant "youth" in the old draconic language, and she was known as "The Renewer.". Treva was a gleaming white dragon with scales that resembled feathers. At full strength, she could breathe a shaft of pure light that could cut through steel. During the Fall of the Primevals, Treva was captured by the white Numena in Argive, where she was crucified in the depths of the city's ancient library. However, millennia later she was freed by Rith and Rhammidarigaaz through the sacrificing of four dragon lords (one of each color except red) of the Dragon Nations. Artifacts known as Tetravuses were artificial creatures created by Tawnos and Urza for the Combined Kingdoms during the Brothers' War. They were composed of four parts and had the power of flight. After the deaths of the Martyrs of Korlis, Urza and Tawnos launched the Tetravuses and Triskelions as their newest battle designs to raid into Fallaji occupied Yotian territories, complementing the pre-existing ornithopters, avengers, yotian soldiers, and clay statues.
Liches are beings who have stored their life force in an object called a phylactery so that their mortal body will endure upwards of millennia in undeath.
Gherridarigaaz was a powerful Shivan dragon who allied herself with Urza on Dominaria.

Warbane is the seventh boss in . He is the Shrine Keeper of the Shrine of Fire, and is the last of the Shrine Keepers Zelda must face before facing Ganon. Warbane is a fiery dragon who guards the final Celestial Sign. Before Ganon's siege over Tolemac, Warbane used to run a locksmith forge with a couple from Great Wimbich. However Ganon had persuaded Warbane into his service, who then built a fortified base of his own, which became the Shrine of Fire in the Forest of Canvula. Warbane also leaves behind the Hammer Spell after Zelda's first encounter with him.

The attack speed of this technique is so fast the it creates after-images of the user's fist in an attempt to fool and distract the opponent and also leaving them unable to properly defend themselves against the actual strikes of his punches.

The Creature from Beneath the Oasis is a creature that appears in the animated series The New Adventures of He-Man. The creature was a hulking reptile that lived underneath the area known as the Oasis on Primus. It had mighty horns and clawed hands, a tough armadillo like hide, glowing red eyes, could breathe fire and a spiked ball at it's tail's end. Once, upon being confronted by He-Man, the evil Skeletor decided to turn and run, but not before he left the hero with 'someone to keep him company'. Atarka (/ətɑːrkə/ uh-TARK-uh) is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir. She is a robust beast with antlers, horns, and fur. She breathes green flames. The ultimate predator, Atarka spends her days, and most of her nights, hunting and feasting.

The Golems are stone creatures that appear in Batman/Fortnite: Zero Point. They are ancient creatures that protect the Entrance halls of The Bridge and are nearly immune to all kinds of weapons, the only way to hurt them is the runes on their face, which is their weakspot.

Taotiemon is a Demon Digimon. One of the "Shikyoju", it is covered in sheep-like fur and dons a bronze decoration like a helmet. Don't be fooled by its young appearance—its innocent face belies its true nature as a mischievous child who loves playing immature and often cruel pranks. Taotiemon can often be seen drifting, cloudlike, through the skies of Jakeizan. With a possible bug in its data causing it to be constantly starving, it attempts to feast as soon as it happens upon prey. When it feeds, the decoration on its head opens up to reveal a horrifying maw. Its binding seals are placed on its head. Along with the blades of its metal wings and hands, its entire body has gained a razor-sharp appearance, and it is surely an Angel Warrior created in order to battle wicked beings. Attacks *Blade of the True (Holy Espada, ): Slashes with a cross-shaped energy blast. *Golden Ripper (Heaven's Ripper): Charges at the opponent with staggering momentum, cutting them to pieces with the blades covering its body.

Its armor has been polished even further, not only raising its defense but also, more importantly, completely changing its attack pattern to become more aggressive. Most prominently, its horn has been transformed into a sword, which it uses for various attacks. Its personality has also changed to become more hostile, and it will boldly challenge any Digimon it deems powerful to a duel. Puttimon is a Mini Angel Digimon. It is a sacred Digimon Baby who is the template for all Angel-type Digimon. On the other hand, it has poor self-judgment between good and evil, and can be quite adorably mischievous. If anything, it's popular for bringing about things like euphoria and good fortune. Though as a newborn, it's rare for it to do so, it can fly skillfully about the sky with the two wings growing from its back. Attacks *Angel Dust: Calls forth a mysterious powder while flying about that places the opponent in a happy mood. *: Spits acid foam at an enemy.

Rebellimon is a Cyborg Digimon. It is a Digimon equipped with a high-powered engine. It is said that a Digimon driven to the brink of death digivolved into it by taking in the junk data around it. It is an outlaw who loots parts from other Machine Digimon in order to further strengthen and remodel its body, which is made out of junk. Occasionally, it has been witnessed roaring noisily around with large gangs of Machmon. Attacks *Vanquish Missile: Fires a large quantity of missiles from its left arm. *Maximum Demolisher: Pulverizes the enemy's body as it minces them with the heavy machinery on its right arm.

Regalecusmon is an Aquatic Digimon. It is an aloof Digimon that hates crowds. As a pirate who repeatedly assaults and loots the feeding grounds and territories of other Digimon, it is also the ruler of the abyss that stands at the apex of the food chain due to its overwhelming power. Its sword, made after tearing off a Zudomon's horn, and the giant pincer on its left arm, are symbols of awe which strike fear into those who see them. Attacks *Briona Strike: Pierces the enemy using the sword in its right hand, along with a flash of lightning. *Reactor Discharge: Blows away everything around it, including seawater, with plasma discharged from its pincer.

Omnimon Zwart is a Holy Warrior Digimon. A member of the Royal Knights that is fused from WarGreymon and MetalGarurumon with the will of those who wish for good. Combining the qualities of both, this Digimon is a flexible fighter. In recent years, it was discovered that if the secretion "Black Digitron" is mixed in with an Omnimon while it is in the process of fusion, it will be temporarily born as a black holy knight. It displays a further increase in power, beginning with the weapons on both of its arms. Attacks *Supreme Cannon (Garuru Cannon): Freezes the opponent with frigid, shots that it fires from the "Garuru Cannon". *Transcendent Sword (Grey Sword): Slashes with the "Grey Sword".

Mistymon is a Warrior Digimon. It is a Digimon who came from another dimension of the Digital World, "Witchelny". In addition to having mastered numerous magic (high-level programming language), it is a sword user who possesses skillful swordsmanship. Well-versed in both knighthood and witchcraft, it can attack with the magical power packed within its sword. Attacks *Core Dart: Freely manipulates a crystal, this is a technique that manages both offense and defense skillfully. *Blast Fire: Raises the power which covered its sword with a single flame, then inflicts slashes.

King Drasil_7D6 is a 9000 lifeform. It is an avatar created by the mysterious host computer King Drasil that governs the entirety of the on the Network. Its body has many unidentified details. Attacks *: Fires crystal shards. *: Fires a gigantic crystal. *: Uses a self-repair ability.

Kutsuna Kaito is character in Digimon Beatbreak. He was the "Fire" member of the Five Stars, titled as "Kaito the Blazing". It was later revealed that he was Sawashiro Kyo's estranged childhood friend during their service in the Five Stars. =Profile= One of the Five Stars, the pinnacle of Cleaners. The Star of Fire, Kaito the Blazing. Short-tempered and violent, he overpowers opponents with brute force. Likes: Game meat. Dislikes: Chocolate. =Appearances=

Gundramon is a Machine Digimon. It is a large Digimon with a massive quantity of firearms. Possessing outstanding firepower, Gundramon, MagnaKidmon, and BeelStarmon are collectively known as the "Three Musketeers" by many Digimon. Furthermore, Gundramon is part of the Crack Team, and is positioned for combat just like Machinedramon. Its speed is faster than that of Machinedramon, and has high maneuverability to move within range in an instant. The 100% full metal comprising its body is ingrained with the burning smell of cartridges, so it is a bitter, hard-boiled Digimon. Attacks *Gewalt Schwärmer (): All-round volley firing. * (): Picks off the enemy's vitals with the six-chambered revolver

Fenriloogamon Takemikazuchi is a Dark Animal Digimon and carrier of the X-Antibody. They say that when Fenriloogamon's DigiCore is filled with strong emotions, the magic inscribed in its is activated and those emotions are made manifest. Fenriloogamon Takemikazuchi is the form that resulted from Kazuchimon's miraculous Digivolution using this magic. The giant sword held in its maw is called . Attacks *: Uses a deadly slashing attack that unleashes the magical powers of flame and lightning from the Takemikazuchi. *: Splits the Takemikazuchi into two, wields them from both ends of Gleipnir, and manipulates Gleipnir at will.

Draxiel was a servant of Mephisto. He was powerful demon, able to twist his foes' emotions to his own ends. At some point after the destruction of Mount Arreat, Draxiel resided in ruins in the southern Dreadlands. The Demon Hunters Delios and Valla entered the ruins, and Draxiel infiltrated their thoughts. In Valla's case, her every irritation with Delios was amplified. Her agitation turned to anger, which in turn, became rage. She turned on Delios, but realized that the one she had been following was a hallucination. Draxiel closed in for the kill, but at this point, Josen and the real Delios arrived. Guuthal the Ever-Fed was an ancient black dragon and a dracolich during the Age of Arcanum.

Dashiell Robert "Dash" Parr is one of the secondary characters in The Incredibles and Incredibles 2. He is the middle child and eldest son of Mr. Incredible and Elastigirl. He has the ability to run much faster than the average person and is fast enough to run on the surface of water. He has an older sister, Violet, and a younger brother, Jack-Jack.

General Bashtar is a boss in Final Fantasy Type-0. He pilots the Gabriel, a flying magitek armor manufactured by the Militesi Empire. He appears in the second and seventh chapters, during missions "The Capture of Togoreth Stronghold" and "Capturing the Imperial Capital".

Gargouille have been told about in stories that they once graced the proud San d'Orian Cathedral coming to life and stealing away the souls of those who lack proper discipline and self-control. While the story may have been a childhood fable meant to instill the best qualities in restless young ones, when it was discovered during the Crystal War that the Allied Forces had to contend with similar living, breathing beasts, the church quickly dismantled all traces of the statuary from the cathedral. The Crushatrice is a species of monster and a specific monster in Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift. They are capable of flight despite their extreme girth, and know a variety of devastating moves, many of which involve jumping into the air and crushing unfortunate foes. The Crushatrice species take up a 3x3 tile area and are unable to move or jump. They have a huge HP stat and often know the Absorb Damage Passive skill, further increasing their vitality. Crushatrice have smaller brethren, the Cockatrice species.

The Zilart are one of the Enlightened Races in Final Fantasy XI. They appear similar to Humes, yet possess extremely high intelligence and magic potential, as well as a trait known as the "whisper of the soul", which is a combination of telepathy and mind reading. An offshoot of the Zilart formed without this trait, known as the Kuluu, and were treated as lesser beings by the Zilart.

White Dragon or , also known as Frost D, White D., and Pale Dim, is a recurring dragon-type enemy in the Final Fantasy series. It is commonly an ice-elemental dragon, and oftentimes appears as a boss.

:For the boss from Final Fantasy VII, see Proud Clod. The Proudclad is a boss in Final Fantasy XIII. It is a machine piloted by Yaag Rosch, capable of flight and able to transform into a spider-like form. Rosch uses the Proudclad to pursue the party after their escape from the Palamecia, and fights them twice in Eden. He drops the Retail Network Eden Pharmaceuticals after the second battle.
Gabe is an oversized cyberdog found in the X-8 research center's testing facility . He is bigger than the other usual police or military cyberdog and is more powerful due to a huge intake of Psycho.

The Xivilai are a powerful Daedra race that exists in the plane of Oblivion, capable of magic. They primarily utilize fireballs and summon Clannfear to their aid. It is best to dispose of a Xivilai before being overwhelmed by the Clannfear minions they can summon. Marksman or melee are most effective against them, because Xivilai have a relatively strong spell absorption bonus. They usually carry a powerful axe or sword, ranging from Dwarven to Daedric, depending on the Hero's level. They can sometimes be found in fellowships of two or three. The Xivilai are the strongest of the Daedra, being able to wield two-handed weapons in one hand.

Seryn, also known as Saint Seryn the Merciful, is a saint of the Tribunal Temple and the Patron of Brewers, Bakers and Distillers. She was a pure virgin of modest aspect, who could cure all diseases at the price of taking the disease upon herself. Tough-minded and fearless, she took on the burdens of others, and bore those burdens to an honored old age. During the events of , shrines dedicated to her can be found across Vvardenfell, inside Temples, such as the High Fane in Vivec City, the Ghostgate Temple in the Ashlands, or the Holamayan Monastery in the Azura's Coast region.

Liches are powerful undead enemies found in the northern regions and in dungeons. It is the most powerful undead in , relying on magic instead of using a bow or melee weapons like other undead. A Lich can be summoned by a Master-level conjurer. They walk with heavy steps when idle and float around rather slowly when alerted. Liches usually carry a staff leveled to the Hero. They can summon other undead such as skeletons and zombies. Even lower level Liches have high resistance to magical attacks. Ancotar is an Altmer and Mages Guild wizard who likes his privacy; he currently resides at Fort Caractacus while performing research. Before the Hero's arrival, he had turned all living people and creatures within a wide radius of his fort, including himself, completely invisible. This caused a problem for the nearby small settlement of Aleswell. When the others are turned back to normal though, he stays invisible. Ancotar made the scroll that made them visible again, and made a protection ring so that there weren't any side effects on the caster. Using the scroll in the area around Ancotar will make him visible and angry at the Hero for taking away his privacy.
Dragonlings are draconic creatures living in areas around the Illiac Bay in . Its main form of attack is fire breathing, but they can be calmed by people capable of speaking Dragonish.
Bladehand Varran was a giant-sized gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos at the very end of the 15 century DR.
The barae were the seven Chosen of Ubtao, undying men and women who ruled the holy city of Mezro as priest-kings.
Bajia was a copper dragon who took the form of a human woman in Silverymoon in the Silver Marches in the 13 century DR.
A fire troll was a large giant that was immune to fire, and vulnerable to cold, the opposite of a typical troll.

Crawford Cordragon, known as the friendly dragon, was a dragon from the Whamite Isles. With his cordial nature and power of flight, Crawford was open to allying with any side in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

The Morrow is Princess Bubblegum's pet falcon and one of several animals that Princess Bubblegum uses for transportation. It takes her to the convention at Veggie Village in the episode "Death in Bloom." Finn mistakes Princess Bubblegum's meaning when she says "I'll be back on the Morrow," thinking she means the next day. This ends up being a problem for Finn and Jake, since the Morrow is a fast flier, and this gives them little time to get the Princess Plant's soul back. The Morrow appears again in "Burning Low," when Princess Bubblegum calls it to take her to the Candy Kingdom. Lovecraft's Dreamlands, depicted as being one of the Great Ones, the gods of Earth that reside in Kadath. He is believed to be the lord of fire and is said to have a handsome face, to be bare-chested, and to be enveloped in blazing flames. Although it may appear to be a simple case of superhuman strength, this is actually an application of the precise chakra control that is used in medical ninjutsu. The user gathers a dense concentration of chakra in their fist that they release on contact with a target. The resulting damage is enough to seriously damage living targets and will likely also do some collateral damage to the surroundings. Ground that is affected by this jutsu fractures and sends small, flower petal-size particles into the air, hence the name.

After receiving Obito's Six Paths Power, Kakashi forms a Lightning Cutter imbued with the power of Kamui. Anything pierced by this technique is instantly warped to Kamui's dimension. Combined with Kamui's intangibility, this technique allows for Kakashi to avoid an enemy's counter.
Yosei (YO-say; ) was the great ryuu (divine dragon) of Kamigawa's plains and the guardian of Eiganjo. He has since reincarnated as Ao, who is male.

Lucius Best, also known as Frozone, is one of the main characters in The Incredibles and Incredibles 2. He is the best friend and a close ally of Mr. Incredible. He has the ability to create ice and freeze surfaces with his hands. He is a long time friend of Mr. Incredible (Bob Parr) and therefore, the Parr family as a whole. He served as the best man in the wedding of Bob Parr and Helen Truax. Although it is believed he is the godfather of Bob's three children, this has not been confirmed in the film. In Incredibles 2 he is referred to as "Uncle Lucius" by Dash Parr, but it is unclear whether he is a biological uncle of Dash, Violet, and Jack-Jack, or if this is simply a title of affection.

Banesword Sephiroth is an enemy that appears in Final Fantasy VII Ever Crisis. He mirrors abilities used by Sephiroth such as Ultimate Flash of Steel (Genji Blade), Firaga A (Prototype Crimson Blade), Lightning Storm (Pandemonic Sword), Raging Flow (Edgar's Coiled Blade ability Royal Shock), Telluric Fury (Nameless), Torrential Thrust (Tempest), Combination Flare (ability Flare Star), and limit break Heliacal Rising.

Aman'Thul (or Aman'thul), the Highfather, is the leader of the titan Pantheon. He is the oldest and wisest of his kind. The titan who originally blessed Nozdormu and the bronze dragonflight, Aman'Thul has mastery over temporal magic. Having led the Pantheon during the ordering of the universe, he and his brothers were felled by Sargeras, their souls held captive by the Dark Titan until they were freed by the heroes of Azeroth. Many of the werewolves in Marvel Comics have a Mythos-connected origin.
